name: uk_flood_precision_medical_case
description: United Kingdom flood preparedness case, 2000-2025 major flood events from EM-DAT, with 3D-printable respiratory circuit connectors as the precision medical component.
author_note: This is a real-case numerical study template. Coordinates are city proxies; transport matrices are provisional values derived from public guide rates and distance formulas; A_max and B_yuan represent the dedicated share of a broader preparedness system allocated to the three modeled item classes.
